$sources: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 2.3.12, Table 6.2.6 row 5(a)-(c) (pp. 541-542): crane impact and horizontal forces
BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 1.6.6(i) (p. 502): moving loads for crane movements

combination.note: SAEngine practice, not BNBC: Table 6.2.6 gives the crane forces but not which act together; the vertical load acts with the transverse or the longitudinal force (each both ways) in the combinations without wind or earthquake, and alone in those with them. Crane loads take the live load factor (Table 6.2.6 is a live load table, Sec 2.3.12).

sources.impact: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Table 6.2.6 row 5(a) (p. 541): electric overhead cranes 25 % of the maximum wheel load; row 5(b) (p. 542): manually operated cranes 50 % of the row 5(a) values (12.5 %); row 5(c) (p. 542): cab-operated travelling cranes 25 %
sources.lateral: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Table 6.2.6 row 5(a)(i) (p. 541): transverse to the rail, 20 % of the weight of the trolley and lifted load only, one-half at the top of each rail
sources.longitudinal: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Table 6.2.6 row 5(a)(ii) (p. 541): along the rail, 10 % of the maximum wheel load at the top of each rail
sources.horizontalScale: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Table 6.2.6 row 5(b) (p. 542): manually operated cranes, 50 % of the row 5(a) horizontal values (transverse 10 %, longitudinal 5 %)
sources.combination: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 1.6.6(i) (p. 502): moving loads for crane movements

notes.pendantOperated: A pendant-operated bridge crane is an electric overhead crane: Table 6.2.6 row 5(a), 25 %
notes.remoteOperated: A remotely operated bridge crane is an electric overhead crane: Table 6.2.6 row 5(a), 25 %
notes.cabOperated: Table 6.2.6 row 5(c) lists cab-operated travelling cranes at 25 % vertical with the horizontal forces not applicable; a cab-operated overhead crane is also an electric overhead crane under row 5(a), so the row 5(a) horizontal forces are applied (the more conservative reading)
notes.monorail: SAEngine practice, not BNBC: BNBC has no monorail row; a powered monorail takes the Table 6.2.6 row 5(a) electric overhead crane values
notes.lateral: SAEngine practice, not BNBC: BNBC takes the trolley and lifted load only; SAEngine also counts the hoist (the trolley weight entered includes it), on the safe side
